questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All J are Y.

II. No X is Y.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some X are not Y.

II. Some J are not X.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b01979a7796c3252990569ea744dcc37c63c74cdb6f9232f3ca3451771b4a7e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some X are not Y → True (As No X is Y so, Some X are not Y is true)

II. Some J are not X → True (As All J are Y and No X is Y so, Some J are not X is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusion I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. (12, 22, 34)

First number + Second number = Third number

 
• (12, 22, 34) → 12 + 22 = 34

and

 
• (14, 15, 29) → 14 + 15 = 29

Similarly,

 
• **(16, 17, 33) → 16 + 17 = 33**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(16, 17, 33)".**

questions.question: Weight of five bags C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5 is compared. Weight of C4 is more than C1 and less than C2. Weight of C5 is more than C3. Weight of C2 is less than C3. Weight of how many bags is less than C2?
questions.solution:
Weight of five bags C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5 is compared.

1) Weight of C4 is more than C1 and less than C2.

C2 > C4 > C1

2) Weight of C2 is less than C3 and Weight of C5 is more than C3. 

C5 > C3 > C2 > C4 > C1

∴ Here, Weight of '2' bags are less than C2.

Hence, the correct answer is **"2".**

questions.question:
Two Statement are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some popcorns are chinese.

All pasta are chinese.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Chinese are pasta.

II. Some popcorns are pasta.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b3291ce2257d513c3da7e550a4199932b008bd22fa70e3c3678a8f606119384.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All Chinese are pasta → False (As All pasta are chinese so, All Chinese are pasta is false)

II. Some popcorns are pasta → False (As Some popcorns are chinese and All pasta are chinese so, Some popcorns are pasta is false)

∴ Here, Both conclusions are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct ? 

4 + 40 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 5 and 16

Given equation is : 4 + 40 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 4 + 40 × 16 - 5 ÷ 8 = 79

⇒ 4 + 40 × 16 - __**5 ÷ 8**__ = 79

⇒ 4 + __**40 × 16**__ - 0.625 = 79

⇒ __**4 + 640**__ - 0.625 = 79

⇒ __**644 - 0.625**__ = 79

⇒ 643.375 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 16 and 4

Given equation is : 4 + 40 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 16 + 40 × 5 - 4 ÷ 8 = 79

⇒ 16 + 40 × 5 - __**4 ÷ 8**__ = 79

⇒ 16 + __**40 × 5**__ - 0.5 = 79

⇒ __**16 + 200**__ - 0.5 = 79

⇒ __**216 - 0.5**__ = 79

⇒ 215.5 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 40 and 16

Given equation is : 4 + 40 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 4 + 16 × 5 - 40 ÷ 8 = 79

⇒ 4 + 16 × 5 - __**40 ÷ 8**__ = 79

⇒ 4 + __**16 × 5**__ - 5 = 79

⇒ __**4 + 80**__ - 5 = 79

⇒ __**84 - 5**__ = 79

⇒ **79 = 79**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : 4 and 40

Given equation is : 4 + 40 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 40 + 4 × 5 - 16 ÷ 8 = 79

⇒ 40 + 4 × 5 - __**16 ÷ 8**__ = 79

⇒ 40 + __**4 × 5**__ - 2 = 79

⇒ __**40 + 20**__ - 2 = 79

⇒ __**60 - 2**__ = 79

⇒ 58 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"40 and 16".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

236 : 33 :: 325 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Sum of units digits of number × 3

236 : 33 → (2 + 3 + 6) × 3 = 11 × 3 = 33

Similarly,

325 : ? → (3 + 2 + 5) × 3 = 10 × 3 = 30

Hence, the correct answer is **"30".**
